comment: Aryl halogenation of various substrates through viral enzymes. MIBig has currently no viral gen clusters in its repository. No specific flavinreductase was identified. PrnF was used instead. PDB ID: 6QGM. Very poor chlorinating activity.

changelog.comment: New entry. Removed NAD as Cofactor. Corrected spelling mistakes.
